name: Add a Sync button to the header through the Git Plugin
description:
## Goal
When the Git Plugin is enabled, add a "Sync" button to the TUI header so users can synchronize Rowbly changes with the current branch’s configured upstream.

## Dependencies
Blocked by ROW-13 (Allow disabling Automatic Commits while the Git Plugin is enabled) and ROW-15 (Add Automatic Merge Conflict Resolution to the Git Plugin). Both Stories must be done before starting this Story.

## Acceptance criteria
- The Git Plugin contributes a "Sync" button to the header when enabled.
- Pressing Sync runs the following sequence: pull the current branch with `git pull --rebase`; stage pending Rowbly Story and configuration changes, including additions and deletions; create a commit when there are changes to commit; and push the current branch to its configured upstream.
- Include pending Rowbly changes when Automatic Commits are disabled. Handle a dirty working tree safely so the pull/rebase can run before the final staging and commit without losing local changes.
- Reuse the conflict-resolution behavior delivered by ROW-15 for Rowbly data and configuration during the rebase. Keep the explicit `git pull --rebase` behavior for this action.
- Coordinate with Automatic Commits, scheduled synchronization and other Rowbly writes. Show progress and prevent duplicate Sync runs while one is active.
- Preserve unrelated working-tree and staged changes; keep Local State, locks and transaction files out of the commit. Do not force-push.
- Show a success toast only after the push succeeds. If pulling, rebasing, staging, committing or pushing fails, show an error toast with an actionable cause and preserve local work for recovery.
- If no Rowbly changes need a commit, skip creating an empty commit and still complete the pull/push synchronization.
- Update the user guide, Git Plugin documentation and published Rowbly skill Git reference for the header action and its interaction with Automatic Commits and automatic synchronization.

## Verification
Use two clones of a temporary remote to verify pulling upstream changes with rebase, committing pending Rowbly Story/configuration changes and pushing successfully. Check success/error toasts, Automatic Commits on and off, no-change runs, overlapping synchronization, Rowbly conflicts, and safe handling of unrelated changes, missing upstream and network/authentication or push failures. Follow the repository test policy for any required data-loss or race regression coverage.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Plan accepted. Complexity 5: a dev worker for research and plan, a fresh dev worker for implementation, then a separate validator. Branch `claude/row-17-header-sync` from `origin/main`; PR against `main`. Scope cut by the user because ROW-13 and ROW-15 are only on `develop`: no ROW-15 conflict resolution, no Automatic Commits toggle, and no CLI command. Plan: the Git Plugin adds a header Sync Action on `S` with a busy state and a guard against running twice, sharing the Automatic Commits queue and worker lock. It commits pending Rowbly data from a snapshot (leaving out Local State, locks, `.txn` and tmp files), fetches, rebases in a temporary worktree (on conflict: abort, keep local work, show an error toast), lands the result with `git reset --keep`, then pushes without force. A success toast appears only after the push. No stash and no Git under the Data Root lock. New ADR-0035; docs and skill references updated.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Draft PR #106 https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/106 from `claude/row-17-header-sync`, head 0c70c9e. The Git Plugin adds a header Sync Action (`S`): commit pending Rowbly data, fetch, rebase in a temporary worktree, land keeping unrelated changes, push without force. The success toast appears only after the push, and errors show recovery hints. New ADR-0035. Validation: typecheck, lint, unit (67) and CLI (20) tests pass, plus manual two-clone TUI runs across success, no-change, conflict, missing upstream, network failure, rejected push, crash recovery and dirty-tree cases; screenshots are on the PR. Left for when `develop` reaches `main`: ROW-15 conflict resolution, handling Automatic Commits off, and moving onto `requestSync`.
